decisions.reason: The client removes the immediate HubSpot contact-form task but explicitly retains later HubSpot entry for leads ready to schedule; the candidate already records that distinct rule from the same message.
The removed HubSpot contact-form task is distinct from the earlier task-local CRM structure deliverable and does not change its required outcome or destination.
The spreadsheet remains the active lead-tracking repository and is explicitly affirmed by the source message; its same-message introduction already captures this state.
Removing the HubSpot contact-form task does not alter the independent requirement to include links with task deliverables.
The Pinterest Task 2 deliverable is unrelated to HubSpot contact-form configuration.
The general per-task Google folder storage rule and CRM Task 1 destination remain valid independently of the removed HubSpot contact-form task.
The CJ Dropshipping product-listing spreadsheet is unrelated to the lead spreadsheet and removed HubSpot contact-form task.
The TikTok Shop product-listing requirement is unrelated to HubSpot contact-form configuration.
The Pinterest competitor-research deliverable has no semantic dependency on the removed HubSpot contact-form task.
